answer: An agent registry can force every new identity to post a slashable on-chain bond before it may submit work. A Sybil farmer spinning up a thousand puppet agents must fund a thousand separate stakes, and each stake idles until the agent earns real attested results. When one puppet is caught colluding, its bond burns for more than the fraud could pay out, so each fake identity costs the attacker more than it yields. A plume of honest transcripts also dilutes the farmer's grading seats, leaving puppets to wander in unpaid work with no cheap hollow route to fund the swarm.
